essence: Dakshinamurti is declared the deity of this Rudra.
The placement is to be made on these specified bodily locations.
One should then perform the third creation placement on the arms in order.
After placing on all fingers with the root mantra, one should perform the pervasion.
One should place on the throat, right arm root, shoulder top, and in-between.
